messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — for SOC2 fieldwork we need a quick pairing session to validate the KMS key-chain and RBAC change log from the March 9 incident. I need chain-of-custody artifacts and a short walkthrough. Available today?

maria: available after 2pm PT. can you list exact artifacts you want so we pre-gather? :clipboard:

auditor_jane: Thanks. Minimal set: 1) signed KMS key rotation history (who/when) 2) CloudTrail entries showing key usage (encrypt/decrypt/grant) 3) RBAC change log + JIRA link for the change that added the service account used in the incident 4) snapshot of our evidence manifest with S3 paths and hashes. A short demo of how you derive chain-of-custody from those logs would be great.

kevin: quick note — the RBAC change was SEC-5421 (merged Mar 9). I can export the audit log and attach.

samir: I can pull the CloudTrail/KMS events and prepare a small export. pulling events with this command:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345 --start-time 2026-03-09T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z > sec5421_ct_export.json
```

maria: for the signed key rotation history we have an internal manifest at s3://redwood-audit/2026/Q1/key-rotations/ and we sign the manifest with our internal sigsvc. Example path I will prepare: s3://redwood-audit/2026/Q1/key-rotations/2026-03-09-rotation-manifest.json (will include sig and sha256).

auditor_jane: Perfect. For the RBAC log we need both the GitHub PR link + cloud IAM policy diff + the time-based approval record. SEC-5421 PR URL pls, and the approver's audit trail.

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4302 — approver was @maria (approved 2026-03-08T20:13:02Z). I'll export review history and include the policy diff.

samir: grab from CloudTrail the kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt and iam:AttachRolePolicy events. here's a sample event snippet I'll include in the bundle:
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-03-09T03:12:21Z",
  "eventName": "Encrypt",
  "awsRegion": "us-west-2",
  "userIdentity": {"arn": "arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/service-account-role/session"},
  "requestParameters": {"keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345"}
}
```

maria: note: for private deployments we also keep offline envelopes in HSM. auditor_jane, do you need HSM export proofs or just KMS/CloudTrail?

auditor_jane: KMS + CloudTrail + HSM attestation would be ideal; if HSM attestation is heavy, initial pass can be KMS+CloudTrail and we will request HSM attestation as a follow-up.

kevin: ok. I'll assemble a small evidence manifest with checksums and presigned URLs for the bundle: s3://redwood-audit/2026/Q1/audits/SEC-5421/manifest.json (will include sha256 and presigned link TTL 7 days).

maria: policy question — retention for these logs is 365 days in primary bucket, archived snapshots (glacier/nearline) beyond that. auditor_jane, is 365d OK for your scope?

auditor_jane: Yes, 365 days covers this audit. Please mark the manifest with retention policy meta so we can reference it in the evidence map.

opsbot: deploy-bot: evidence-bundle/SEC-5421 uploaded by kevin at 2026-03-21T21:35:00Z — s3://redwood-audit/2026/Q1/audits/SEC-5421/bundle.zip (sha256: 3f7a9c...)

samir: bundle includes: cloudtrail_export.json, key_rotation_manifest.json, rbacs_change_log.json, pr_4302_review_history.json, manifest.json. I'll also include a short readme describing how to validate signatures and hashes.

auditor_jane: Great — can we do a 15-min pairing at 2:30pm PT to walk through the chain-of-custody steps and show how to validate the manifest? If someone can share screen to step through: verify sha256, validate sigsvc signature, and show cloudtrail event linking to the service account used in the incident. :eyes:

maria: confirmed 2:30pm PT — i'll share my screen. kevin/samir pls join.

kevin: joining. I'll have the PR and policy diff ready.

samir: joining. I'll have the CloudTrail snippet open and the aws command to re-run locally.

auditor_jane: Thanks — one more ask: please include a brief mapping doc (one slide) that maps these artifacts to SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO 27001 A.9.2 evidence points. helps speed reviewer notes.

maria: will attach short mapping slide to the manifest. :thumbsup:

auditor_jane: excellent — see you at 2:30.

maria: uploading the manifest now. link in bundle.
